info.name: Anajao Milestone 02 — Identity and Access
info.description: Manual workflow collection; see docs/identity.md. Successful delivery examples require a verified adapter. Default server returns 503 for delivery and social providers. Examples are illustrative, not captured production responses. Do not run every request sequentially: logout/reset/MFA/deletion invalidate sessions.
